dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-colored rings with sharp outer boundaries and dark-toned internal centers; three large, distinct closed loops are clustered on the mid-dorsal region with well-defined high-contrast gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of localized, solid dark speckles without internal gradients, primarily situated in the interstitial regions between the larger ring structures and increasing in frequency toward the anterior neck region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: An approximate equilateral triangle is formed by the centroids of three primary rings on the central flank, with a secondary linear chain of smaller ring structures extending toward the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced longitudinal skin folds or ridges are visible at the base of the posterior flippers, exhibiting distinct shadowing under high-contrast illumination.
